area: West Ham / Plaistow marsh north of Canning Town: open marsh with looping drains, school (Boys Girls & Infants), G.E.R. Woolwich Branch strip on the W edge, Malmesbury / Avondale Road terraces and new streets in the south
method: sheet (no join reported) + 9 sweep crops at 2x, every one displayed and anchored when opened: r0c0 B.M.7.02 + cross-hatched sheds; r0c1 'School' + curving drain; r0c2 blank marsh with double-line drains; r1c0 'G.E.R.'/'F.B.'/outline 'S H'; r1c1 'School Boys Girls & Infants'/B.M.8.46; r1c2 looping drain; r2c0 'MALMESBURY'/'AVONDALE ROAD'; r2c1 'AVONDALE ROAD' + survey triangle; r2c2 rotated 'D A L' / 'C L' street names. Contact sheets csA (6-12x), csB (14-16x), csC (nearest-neighbour 10x), csD (20x on B.M. leading digits and 6.8), csE (8x on the overlap-strip marks and a 4x join panel), all displayed. Dots by darkness-centroid helper, checked on marker sheets.
legibility: good; vertical sheet join at px ~347-348 (tint step with a straight line full height), tool reports none; nothing cut by edges except the 'M' lettering at 638,1020
